title: Panama Canal Neopanamax Draft Falls to 48 Feet as Fifth Water-Conservation Cut Takes Effect
detail: The Panama Canal Authority's reduction of the maximum Neopanamax draft to 48 feet (14.63 m) took effect Aug. 26, 2026 — the fourth cut since July and the fifth since the water-conservation program began in December 2025. A further reduction to 47.5 feet is scheduled for Sep. 3. The Authority said the adjustment reflects ongoing technical monitoring and forecasts of the El Niño phenomenon's potential impact on Gatun Lake levels, and that daily vessel transit numbers would not be reduced for now.

media.caption: Panama Canal Authority cuts Neopanamax draft limit to 48 feet effective Aug. 26, 2026

title: Haze From Indonesian Fires Threatens Malaysia's National Day Celebrations
detail: Malaysia's government said it may scale back or postpone National Day celebrations (Aug. 31) if smoke drifting from Indonesian forest and peatland fires persists, after Swiss air-quality monitors ranked Kuala Lumpur the world's second-most polluted major city. Indonesia stepped up its aerial firefighting response as the region approaches the historical August-September peak of its haze season — rated 'Red,' the highest risk level since 2023, in the Singapore Institute of International Affairs' 2026 outlook — driven by the intensifying El Niño's drier conditions across Sumatra and Kalimantan.

media.caption: Haze from Indonesian wildfires threatens Malaysia's National Day celebrations
